*My cat got a plastic rope inside. The vet recommended giving him medication to induce vomiting. If he didn't vomit, we would need to do a gastric lavage. If we didn't do it within 4 hours, the rope might get tangled in his intestines. So we decided to do it. After the lavage, the cat's condition worsened significantly, and he died the next day!
*After the cat died, I tried asking at other hospitals. They recommended a different approach: waiting 2-3 days to see if he recovered, then considering surgery. They also advised against gastric lavage in cats because they tend to struggle.
*I'm so heartbroken. If I hadn't taken him to this hospital, my cat might not have died.
